description_expanded: Sunshine is never in short supply at Laguna Loafin’, a beautiful Gulf-front home located in Panama City Beach! With a private pool and private beach access, you’ll have no problem working on that summer tan. Near shopping, dining, and plenty of Panama City Beach attractions, there’s no end to the fun you and your family will have! Laguna Loafin’ is a gorgeous four-story home with five bedrooms and three and a half baths accommodating up to fifteen. Stunning interiors bathed in calming hues invite you into this elegant home for a relaxing and peaceful stay. First-floor features include a queen bunk room and a queen suite with an en suite bath, a flat-screen TV, and private access to the pool and beach outside. The whole family will enjoy hours of entertainment in the game room with a flat-screen TV, billiards, ping pong, and foosball! The second floor houses an expansive living area with a sizeable kitchen and two decks, lovely spots to gather for quiet conversation or just take in the Gulf breezes. Make your way to the third floor to find three more bedrooms, including a stunning master suite with a king-sized bed, en-suite bathroom, and private balcony. An additional queen suite, triple bunk room, and extra bunks ensure everyone gets a good night’s rest. The fourth floor will undoubtedly be the most popular spot for gathering at the end of the day, offering 360-degree views, a wet bar, and a sundeck with lounge chairs. With three refrigerators, double washers and dryers, double dishwashers, and a sound system set to the perfect beach vibe for endless entertainment, all that’s left for you to do is relax and enjoy! Hang out at the private pool or venture to the sugar-white shores for sun-filled days at the beach. With so much nearby, you’ll want to get out and explore! Head west to Inlet Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach, peaceful communities on 30A with fantastic open-air eateries and boutiques. Head east to Pier Park, an outdoor entertainment center with specialty shops, restaurants, and a state-of-the-art movie theater for even livelier entertainment. There’s no end to the fun you can have in Panama City Beach! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
